title: Chicken Biryani

overview.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with tender chicken pressure cooked to perfection.

ingredients: 1 tsp of saffron mixed with 1 tbsp of warm milk
method: Heavily slice the chicken legs all over
Marinate the chicken and refigerate for 4 - 24 hours
Wash the basmati rice until the water runs clear.
Add half the ghee to the instant pot
Cook the onions slowly for an hour until fully caramelised
Remove a third of the onions to use a garnish
Deglaze the pot with the liquids from the marinated chicken
Add the other half of the ghee to the instant pot
Add bay leaves chicken and pressure cook for 6 minutes
Add the rice and water, push the rice under the water. Do not stir. Pressure cook for 8 minutes
Garnish the biryani with halved eggs, safron mixed with water, and coriander leaves

learning.did-you-know: The word 'biryani' comes from a Persian word meaning 'fried before cooking', reflecting its Persian influence and layered cooking method.
learning.what-you-will-learn: How to parboil basmati rice, prepare a vegetable masala and finish a biryani using the traditional dum steaming technique.

notes.why-its-in-the-chapman-kitchen: A complete meal that showcases authentic biryani technique while using everyday vegetables from the pantry and freezer.
chapman-tips: Keep the heat very low during the final steaming stage.
Fresh mint makes a noticeable difference to the finished dish.
Let the biryani rest before fluffing to prevent the rice breaking.
notes.batch-cooking: Freeze in family-sized portions. Reheat gently with a splash of water.
notes.leftovers: Excellent reheated the following day or served with a fried egg.
